title: Exam Review
goals: mengingat kembali semua **tense** yang sudah dipelajari dari Kelas 7 sampai 9
membedakan **jenis teks**: narrative, recount, procedure, descriptive, report, announcement, invitation, letter
mengenal pola soal ujian dan strategi menjawabnya

lesson.text: Selamat, ini unit terakhir! Di **Unit 8 Kelas 9** kamu **mengulang semuanya**: tense, jenis teks, dan tips mengerjakan soal ujian. Baca rangkuman di bawah dengan santai, lalu kerjakan Latihan dan Kuis campuran.

lesson.title: Cara memilih tense
lesson.text: Cari **kata petunjuk waktu**: *every day, usually* (simple present); *now, at the moment* (present continuous); *yesterday, last week, ago* (simple past); *while, when* (past continuous); *ever, never, already, yet, for, since* (present perfect); *tomorrow, next week* (future).

lesson.title: 3. Daftar cepat grammar penting
table: I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are; lampau was/were
negatif dan pertanyaan simple present; setelahnya kata kerja dasar
negatif dan pertanyaan simple past; setelahnya kata kerja dasar
can, must, should, may, will + kata kerja dasar (tanpa to dan tanpa -s)
taller than, the tallest; more beautiful, the most beautiful
If + simple present, will + kata kerja dasar
to be + past participle (is made, was built)
at + jam; on + hari/tanggal; in + bulan/tahun

lesson.title: 4. Strategi mengerjakan soal ujian
lesson.text:
1. **Baca soal dua kali** dan garis bawahi kata kuncinya (when, who, how many).
2. **Baca teks dulu** (jika ada), lalu cari jawaban dengan kata kunci.
3. **Coret pilihan yang jelas salah**, lalu pilih yang paling tepat dari sisanya.
4. Untuk soal grammar, **cari kata petunjuk waktu** (yesterday, now, for, since).
5. **Jangan terlalu lama** pada satu soal; tandai dan kembali nanti.
6. **Periksa kembali** jawaban sebelum mengumpulkan.

lesson.title: Perkaya kosakata setiap hari
lesson.text: Dengarkan lagu atau video berbahasa Inggris, tulis 5 kata baru per hari, dan coba pakai dalam kalimat. Klik kata berwarna di unit sebelumnya untuk melatih pelafalan.

items: Modal dan did/does: kata kerja kembali ke **bentuk dasar**.
Terus berlatih: kosakata, membaca, dan berbicara sedikit setiap hari. 🎉

read.id:
Liburan lalu, kelasku mengunjungi Candi Borobudur. Candi itu dibangun lebih dari seribu tahun lalu dan merupakan candi Buddha terbesar di dunia. Kami berangkat dari sekolah pukul lima pagi dan tiba pukul delapan.
Kami sedang menaiki tangga ketika hujan mulai turun, jadi kami memakai payung. Pemandu menjelaskan bahwa candi itu memiliki banyak relief tentang kehidupan Buddha. Jika kamu pernah mengunjungi Borobudur, kamu akan terkagum-kagum. Aku belum pernah melihat tempat seindah itu.

qs.q: What time did the class arrive at Borobudur?

qs.exp: Teks: "We were walking up the stairs when it started to rain".
qs.q: What were they doing when it started to rain?

qs.exp: Teks: "reliefs about the life of Buddha."
Teks: "I have never seen such a beautiful place."
qs.q: How does the writer feel about Borobudur?

read.text:
Last holiday, my class visited Borobudur Temple. It was built more than a thousand years ago and is the largest Buddhist temple in the world. We left school at five in the morning and arrived at eight.
We were walking up the stairs when it started to rain, so we used umbrellas. The guide explained that the temple has many reliefs about the life of Buddha. If you ever visit Borobudur, you will be amazed. I have never seen such a beautiful place.
read.title: A Day at Borobudur

read.id:
Hidup sehat membutuhkan kebiasaan baik. Pertama, kamu sebaiknya makan buah dan sayur setiap hari. Kedua, kamu harus minum delapan gelas air. Jika kamu tidur kurang dari tujuh jam, kamu akan merasa lelah di kelas.
Olahraga juga penting. Tahun lalu, pamanku sakit karena dia tidak pernah berolahraga. Setelah dia mulai jogging, dia menjadi lebih sehat. Sekarang dia sudah jogging selama enam bulan, dan dia lebih bahagia daripada sebelumnya.

qs.q: How many glasses of water should you drink?

qs.exp: Teks: "you will feel tired in class."
qs.q: What will happen if you sleep less than seven hours?
Why was the uncle sick last year?
How long has the uncle been jogging?

read.text:
A healthy life needs good habits. First, you should eat fruit and vegetables every day. Second, you must drink eight glasses of water. If you sleep less than seven hours, you will feel tired in class.
Exercise is also important. Last year, my uncle was sick because he never exercised. After he started jogging, he became healthier. Now he has been jogging for six months, and he is happier than before.
read.title: Reading Review: Healthy Habits

read.id:
Rina telah tinggal di Bandung sejak 2020. Setiap pagi, dia berjalan ke sekolah bersama teman-temannya. Kemarin, dia sedang berjalan pulang ketika hujan mulai turun, jadi dia berlari ke sebuah kafe.
Saat ini, dia sedang menulis cerita tentang sekolahnya. Tahun lalu, ceritanya diterbitkan di majalah sekolah. Dia baru saja menyelesaikan bab baru, dan besok dia akan mengirimkannya kepada gurunya.

qs.exp: Teks: "At the moment, she is writing a story".
qs.q: What is Rina doing at the moment?

qs.exp: Teks: "tomorrow she will send it to her teacher".
options: Send a chapter to her teacher
Publish a magazine for the school
Move to Bandung with her family

qs.q: Which tense is "has lived in Bandung since 2020"?

qs.exp: Kejadian yang sedang berlangsung ketika terpotong → was + V-ing.
qs.q: Yesterday, Rina ___ (walk) home when it started to rain.
Last year, her story ___ (publish) in the school magazine.

qs.answer: She has just finished a new chapter.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Dia baru saja menyelesaikan bab baru."

read.text:
Rina has lived in Bandung since 2020. Every morning, she walks to school with her friends. Yesterday, she was walking home when it started to rain, so she ran to a cafe.
At the moment, she is writing a story about her school. Last year, her story was published in the school magazine. She has just finished a new chapter, and tomorrow she will send it to her teacher.
read.title: Review: A Year in Rina's Life
